rules.statement: An order for abatement of an action due to the plaintiff's death can be set aside if the application is made within a reasonable time and the applicant was prevented by sufficient cause from continuing the action.
rules.supporting_quote: "In terms of section 403 of the Code the order could be set aside upon an application made by a person claiming to be the plaintiff's legal representative if the application was made within a reasonable time and it was proved that he was prevented by sufficient cause from continuing the action."

meta.parties: Simeon Silva, E. v. Sivasupramaniam Ambalam, A.K.N
